title: Chicken Stroganoff
description: Sous vide chicken thighs and tenders seared and finished in a Dijon and Worcestershire cream sauce with portobellos, over egg noodles.

ingredients.name: cornstarch
ingredients.note: for slurry, may need slightly more

ingredients.name: No Yolks extra broad egg noodles

steps.title: Sous vide
steps.text: Place the chicken bagless on separate racks in the Anova Precision Oven with the bottom drip pan installed. Run 145°F, 100% steam, for 2 hours. Cool slightly.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Cut the chicken into 1 inch chunks, keeping thighs and tenders separate.

steps.title: Sear chicken
steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of {oil} in a cast iron skillet over high heat. Sear the thighs in a single layer until browned, about 1 minute per side. Repeat with the tenders and the remaining oil. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook mushrooms
steps.text: Cook {mushrooms} in {butter} over medium-high heat 8 to 10 minutes until the liquid cooks off and they brown. Pre-cooking drives off water so it does not thin the sauce.

steps.title: Roux
steps.text: Sprinkle {flour} and {onion} over the mushrooms and stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Build sauce
steps.text: Stir in {worcestershire} and {mustard}. Gradually add {broth}, then {cream}. Simmer 8 minutes.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Whisk {cornstarch} into {slurrywater}, stir it in, and simmer 2 minutes. Add a little more slurry or a splash of chicken broth to adjust the thickness.

steps.title: Combine and hold
steps.text: Add the seared chicken to the sauce. Hold on low heat without sour cream until ready to serve.

steps.title: Cook noodles
steps.text: Cook {noodles} in salted water according to the package. Drain.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Kill the heat and stir in {sourcream} right before serving so it does not break. Serve over the noodles.

notes: Sauce quantities come from the saved version; chicken, onion, mushroom prep and noodle amounts are starting points. Do not boil after adding the sour cream. Freezes best before the sour cream goes in; add it fresh when reheating.
